text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up for last night's page — noise surge from late-night batch jobs. Quick summary + action items below.

maria: Key points: noisy alerts came from job_timeouts and very low-severity spikes; dedupe failed for a dozen sources; paging went to SRE even though it should've been only infra-owner on-call.

maria: Proposed remediation checklist (short):
- owner: @sophie -> review alert thresholds + prod metrics (deadline: Thu EOD)
- owner: @leo -> dedupe rule tweak + add fingerprinting (deadline: Mon next week)
- owner: @raj -> paging policy change to route only infra-owner for infra.* alerts (deadline: Fri)
- owner: @alex -> runbook + automated suppression for nightly batch windows (PS: need kubernetes job tags)

raj: Ack. I'll take the routing change. quick question: do we want to route infra.* to infra-owner only, or keep a fallback to platform-sre after 30m?

maria: Let's keep fallback after 30m but set alert severity to P3 so paging is suppressed initially. We want visibility in Slack only for the first 30m.

sophie: I'll baseline the metric histograms this morning and post a delta. plan: bump timeout threshold from 30s -> 90s for that job family, then monitor.

leo: I'll try a conservative dedupe tweak first: group by (job_name, cluster, error_type) and increase grouping window to 10m. If noise persists, move to 30m.

alex: I'll add a runbook section for scheduled-job noise and an automated suppression rule that checks `job_schedule == nightly`. Draft suppression rule below:
```json
{
  "name": "nightly-batch-suppression",
  "match": "job_schedule == \"nightly\" && severity == \"P4\"",
  "suppress_for_minutes": 480,
  "notify_channel": "#observability-ops"
}
```

oncall-bot: ticket created: PM-8243 "Alert tuning: nightly batch noise" assigned to @sophie/@leo/@raj/@alex — https://issues.redwood.example/PM-8243

maria: Can each owner drop a one-line status update in this thread when done? I want to roll up at the next sync.

sophie: status: baseline collected, 95th pct for job X is 78s, proposing threshold 120s. will open PR to alert rule by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

leo: status: dedupe rule PR opened -> PR#412 in observability repo. testing in staging now. :construction:

raj: status: routing change submitted to infra teams, scheduling canary for Fri 10:00 UTC. added fallback after 30m.

alex: status: runbook draft pushed to docs, suppression rule staged in Feature Flags. need one more approval from security (cc @maria).

maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) if PRs land and staging looks good, we flip to prod on Mon 02:00 UTC. 2) I'll attach a small eval prompt set to Redwood Optimize to track quality regressions after threshold changes.

sophie: noted. adding a small eval -> will include 20 sample traces from affected jobs.

leo: If noise reduces by >90% after change, we can consider relaxing grouping after 2 weeks.

alex: tagging the runbook link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/alert-tuning

maria: closing loop — please update PM-8243 with final status and close the ticket when all four owners confirm prod flip succeeded.

raj: will do.

sophie: done when merged + verified in prod, I'll post here.

leo: likewise.

maria: one more note: capture the incident pattern in the recurring-incidents doc (owner: maria) so we can detect similar patterns automatically.

maria: thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
